queries:
WITH overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS oavg FROM sentimentandfundamentals WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL
),
grp AS (
  SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS gavg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY eventannotm
)
SELECT AVG(g.gavg) AS mean_avg_ownership,
       AVG(ABS(g.gavg - o.oavg)) AS mean_diff_above_average
FROM grp g, overall o
WHERE g.gavg > o.oavg;
WITH g AS (
  SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS a
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY eventannotm
),
o AS (
  SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM g
)
SELECT AVG(g.a) AS mean_avg_ownership,
       AVG(g.a - o.m) AS mean_above_average
FROM g, o
WHERE g.a > o.m;
WITH g AS (
  SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS a
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY eventannotm
),
o AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS v
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE eventannotm IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(g.a) AS mean_avg_ownership, AVG(g.a - o.v) AS mean_diff_above_overall
FROM g, o
WHERE g.a > o.v;
WITH g AS (
  SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS a, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY eventannotm
),
o AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS oa
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
)
SELECT SUM(g.a * g.n) * 1.0 / SUM(g.n) AS weighted_mean_avg_ownership,
       SUM((g.a - o.oa) * g.n) * 1.0 / SUM(g.n) AS weighted_mean_excess
FROM g, o
WHERE g.a > o.oa;
